character.description: The same young adult woman anime protagonist in every scene: glossy dark-brown hair in a high festival ponytail tied with a vermilion ribbon, bright amber eyes, a lively recognizable face, and consistent adult proportions. She is a summer festival dance leader who teaches neighborhood children the traditional bon-odori steps. Her fixed signature outfit is a deep indigo yukata with small white fireworks, a vivid coral obi, and practical geta sandals. Her defining personal object is a small uchiwa fan painted with a goldfish and summer stars. Preserve her exact face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, body proportions, yukata pattern, obi, and fan throughout the entire music video.
consistency_rules: Keep this exact summer-festival protagonist as the single lead throughout the theme.
Preserve her face, hairstyle, hair color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions.
Keep the indigo fireworks yukata, coral obi, and goldfish uchiwa fan consistent in every scene.
Do not replace the protagonist or introduce another lead unless the lyrics explicitly require one.
